title: Unit Schema
description: Unit within a course, containing lessons

globalId.description: Stable RFC 4122 UUID identifying this unit across re-imports. Required by NORMATIVE §4.4: every Unit, Lesson, Item, and Question MUST carry a globalId.

tags.description: Optional taxonomic tags for filtering, search, and gradebook grouping. Free-form strings; conventional namespaces use colons (e.g. 'psychology:social', 'stage:upper-secondary', 'qualification:ap-psychology'). Independent of any tags on inner lessons, items, or questions.

objectiveIds.description: Objective IDs assigned to this unit (references course.objectives[].id)
